officialRulebookTextOccurrences.sourceText: Shuffle all Queen Health cards and place them numbers-side down; place a Universal marker on 0 of the Queen's Hits track.
A Character may apply any number of Burst Hits to the Queen up to her Hits track maximum; leftover Hits are lost.
Shoot deals 1 Hit before the Shoot roll; Larvae and the Queen use different Health resolution.
Melee deals 1 Hit before its Shoot-die roll; the Queen's Health resolves differently.
For each Hit dealt to the Queen, advance the Universal marker on the Queen's Hits track by 1 instead of placing markers near the model.
Whenever the marker reaches the final space, ignore any further Hits in that Action and draw the top Queen Health card.
Discard the shown number of additional cards without revealing them, then resolve the bottom effect even if the Queen dies from the additional discards.
Discard the drawn card and reset the Universal marker to 0.
When the last Queen Health card is discarded, remove the Queen model, ignore future Queen placements, and flip the Intruder Help sheet.
The Queen Attacks a Character in her Room if possible, otherwise moves once toward the closest Character using the stated tie-breaks.
A Character Repelling an Intruder from the same Room chooses the exit Corridor; other Repel destinations use lowest ID and preserve Door/entry consequences.
When an Action deck has no card to draw, shuffle that Character's discard pile into a new deck and continue drawing.
All effects mentioning Characters resolve in Turn order.
A Room holds at most one Malfunction; repeated placement is ignored; if the supply is empty place Fire in the Room instead if possible.
Reinforcing an empty Corridor discards Noise and flips the Corridor to its value-0 side.
Facility destruction kills all Intruders, including the Queen.

faqOccurrences.printedText:
How does shooting at the Queen work exactly?
Shooting at the Queen works exactly the same as it does for Adult Intruders, but instead of removing the miniature from the board, you resolve the Queen health card instead. Shooting a Queen with 2 hits will result in resolving the top card of the Queen Health Deck, if a player rolls a 2 (or fewer) or a skull symbol.

selectedEvidence.visibleDiscriminator: The three labeled 3 crops place their numerals in, respectively, a solid red triangle, purple rounded square, and yellow diamond, whereas the source has a separated glowing green perimeter with open side gaps. The greenItem crop is a solid green octagon containing a white plus. The frame-like burstDieAdditionalEffects crop has four white corner brackets on a filled purple square and no central numeral. None of the 49 crops reproduces the complete source frame-and-glyph morphology.

iconOccurrences.literalAppearance: The source and character crop share the same ordered pixel structure: arched head opening, horizontal neck separation, squared shoulders, articulated bent arms, rectangular chest void, narrowed waist, and split lower form. The robot crop instead has a short antenna, broad domed body, and two circular eye openings, without articulated arms, a rectangular chest opening, or paired lower limbs. These visible internal features discriminate character from robot without using the surrounding sentence.
